newsitem.title: UK: Lucky callers beat millions to Concorde flights.
newsitem.headline: Lucky callers beat millions to Concorde flights.

text.p: Nearly 200 people Wednesday celebrated beating 30 million other callers to snap up Concorde plane tickets for just 10 pounds ($16).
Telephone lines were jammed as millions of people called a special British Airways hotline to buy the limited 190 Concorde tickets on sale for a fraction of their 5,400 pound ($8,710) cost.
The tickets for a supersonic round trip flight from London to New York were taken in less than 30 minutes as bargain-hunters around the world rushed to pick up the offer.
The Concorde tickets were offered at the special price by British Airways to celebrate the company's 10th anniversary since its privatisation.
British Telecom said calls were taken from as far away as Russia and Australia.
Among the lucky few who managed to buy the tickets were two people from Essex, in eastern England, calling from the same house -- one on a landline and one on a mobile phone.
Other winners included callers from California, Vienna, the Netherlands, London and Newcastle.
A BA spokesman said switchboard took half a million calls in just three hours after the number was announced in the morning.
"We received a further 750,000 calls in the 60 minutes building up to the magic hour," he said.
